preconditions.expression: all(line.strip().isdigit() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Every non-empty line in stdin consists of a single integer.

preconditions.expression: int(stdin.splitlines()[0].strip()) == t and t >= 1 and t <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The first line is t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^5), the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.strip()) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1])
preconditions.description: Each of the next t lines contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines() == [str(max_remaining(n)) for n in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]]]
postconditions.description: For each n, stdout contains the maximum number of people that could remain after all elimination rounds, where max_remaining(n) is the answer for input n.

postconditions.expression: max_remaining(n) == 1 if n == 1 else max_remaining(n) == 1 if n == 2 else max_remaining(n) == 1 if n == 3 else max_remaining(n) == 2 if n == 4 else max_remaining(n) == 2 if n == 5 else max_remaining(n) == 3 if n == 6 else max_remaining(n) == 3 if n == 7 else max_remaining(n) == 4 if n == 8 else max_remaining(n) == 4 if n == 9 else max_remaining(n) == 5 if n == 10 else max_remaining(n) == 1 + (n - 1) // 2 if n > 10 else False
postconditions.description: The answer for n is 1 for n ≤ 3, 2 for 4 ≤ n ≤ 5, 3 for 6 ≤ n ≤ 7, 4 for 8 ≤ n ≤ 9, 5 for n = 10, and 1 + floor((n - 1) / 2) for n > 10. This captures the maximum stable set size in a graph where each elimination round removes nodes with degree k (k = 0, 1, 2, ..., n-1 in sequence).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line.strip()) <= n for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer ≤ n.
